summary:
AstroFirma is a neuro-symbolic crop rotation and climate resilience engine that turns a single map pin anywhere on Earth into a biologically verified, climate-stress-tested 4-year crop rotation plan.

We developed a four-stage pipeline integrating: (1) Multi-sensor NASA Earth Observation fusion (NASA POWER, GPM IMERG, SMAP L4, HLS, NASADEM, MODIS/ECOSTRESS, and SoilGrids 2.0) to diagnose bare-soil storm erosion and root-zone water deficits; (2) an Agronomic Knowledge Graph & FAO-56/RUSLE Physics Oracle encoding 60 crops and hard biological/erosion constraints; (3) a Guided Discrete Diffusion Planner with hard logit masking that generates 12-season rotations with 0.0% biological violations while protecting Year 1–2 farm income; and (4) a 1D Weather Diffusion Stress-Tester & Counterfactual RAG Copilot that evaluates rotations across 100 synthetic 4-year weather futures (

This matters because farmers worldwide lack accessible tools to transition from brittle monocultures to climate-resilient, soil-regenerating rotations without risking short-term income or topsoil loss.
details:
AstroFirma is a neuro-symbolic crop rotation and climate resilience engine that turns a single map pin anywhere on Earth into a biologically valid, climate-stress-tested 4-year crop rotation plan (4 years×3 seasonal windows=124 \text{ years} \times 3 \text{ seasonal windows} = 124 years×3 seasonal windows=12 slots):

  1. Multi-Sensor NASA EO Fusion (backend/eo/): Queries live NASA POWER daily agroclimatology and fuses pre-aggregated 30m–9km satellite layers (HLS NDVI/NDTI, GPM IMERG convective storm intensity, SMAP L4 root-zone soil moisture, NASADEM slope/TWI, MODIS/ECOSTRESS ET, and ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0) into five interpretable indicators (zNASA\mathbf{z}_{\text{NASA}}zNASA​) and a Satellite Health Card.
  2. Agronomic Knowledge Graph & Physics Oracle (backend/agronomy/): Uses a curated 60-crop database (EcoCrop + pyfao56 + USDA SARE) to prune locally viable crops (Vlocal\mathcal{V}_{\text{local}}Vlocal​), enforce hard biological and erosion rules (Mvalid\mathbf{M}_{\text{valid}}Mvalid​: family pathogen breaks, 2-year cyclic wraps, turnaround windows, and mandatory cover crops during high storm-erosion months), and score schedules with a vectorized FAO-56 water-bucket + RUSLE erosion + Year 1–2 income-floor oracle (RagroR_{\text{agro}}Ragro​).
  3. Guided Discrete Diffusion Planner (backend/planner/): Generates all 12 seasonal slots simultaneously via Classifier-Free Guidance over farmer priorities (Soil, Water, Cash, Erosion) and hard log⁡Mvalid\log \mathbf{M}_{\text{valid}}logMvalid​ logit projection—guaranteeing 0.0% biological violations across 500 held-out global farms.
  4. 1D Weather Diffusion Stress-Tester & Counterfactual RAG Copilot (backend/stress_rag/): Synthesizes 100 4-year dekadal weather futures to compute CVaR10%\text{CVaR}_{10\%}CVaR10%​, drought survival rate, and topsoil protection scores, paired with a Genetic Algorithm optimizer and a cited extension RAG copilot for live crop swaps.
  5. Interactive 3D Cockpit (frontend/): A Next.js + MapLibre GL + Three.js dashboard featuring 3D terrain & 4-year crop/soil simulation, diffusion unmasking animation, 100-trajectory fan charts, and a farmer seed calendar.

Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Zero-Lab Global Onboarding: Works from a single map pin without soil lab tests or PhD-level simulator calibration.
  • Targeted Erosion Shielding: Pinpoints exact months where bare soil collides with intense storms (IerosionI_{\text{erosion}}Ierosion​) and plugs them with nitrogen-fixing cover crops.
  • Income-Protected Transition: Enforces a Year 1–2 gross-margin floor (≥80%\ge 80\%≥80% of baseline) so smallholders can regenerate soil without suffering an abrupt income drop.
  • Climate Shock Insurance: Replaces static averages with 100-scenario tail-risk (CVaR10%\text{CVaR}_{10\%}CVaR10%​) scoring usable by farmers, cooperatives, and agricultural micro-insurers.

Tools, Languages, Hardware & Software Used

  • Languages: Python 3, TypeScript / JavaScript
  • Backend & AI/Simulation: FastAPI, Uvicorn, PyTorch (Masked Discrete Diffusion Transformer & 1D Conditional U-Net), NumPy, SciPy, NetworkX, HTTPX, Pytest
  • Frontend & 3D Visualization: Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS, MapLibre GL, Three.js
  • Geospatial & Compute: Google Earth Engine API, NASA POWER REST API, local CPU/GPU training & inference

How Is It Creative & What Factors Did We Consider?

  • Neuro-Symbolic AI: Instead of letting an unconstrained LLM or autoregressive model hallucinate impossible planting sequences, we bind a bidirectional Discrete Diffusion model inside a symbolic Graph-RAG validity manifold (log⁡Mvalid\log \mathbf{M}_{\text{valid}}logMvalid​).
  • Spatial Scale-Bridging: Combines coarse atmospheric missions (10–50 km GPM/SMAP/POWER) with 30m field topography and canopy cover (NASADEM/HLS) so sloped hillside parcels and flat valley bottoms receive tailored plans.
  • Practical Adoption Factors: Modeled Year 1–2 household cash-flow protection, regional crop/price plug-in packs, and low-bandwidth farmer seed calendars.
